questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All rhombuses are tangents.

All chords are tangents.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some rhombuses being chords is a possibility.

II. Some tangents are rhombuses.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d5c2dab2740321d5021cfc3399abcecbd4e03e5e7839ebb76b50fe5a97677b5.png] 

**Conclusion:**

I) Some rhombuses being chords is a possibility → True (As all rhombuses are tangents. So, some rhombuses being chords is definite true.)

II) Some tangents are rhombuses → True (As all rhombuses are tangents and all chords are tangents, so some tangents are rhombuses is definite true.)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Both conclusions I and II follows".**

questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

P _ Q U _ V _ T _ U R V P T Q _ R _ P _ Q U _ V

options.text: P, T, Q, R, T, V, R, U
R, T, P, Q, T, U, R, V
T, P, R, Q, T, U, V, R
T, R, P, Q, U, V, T, R

questions.solution:
Given: P _ Q U _ V _ T _ U R V P T Q _ R _ P _ Q U _ V

1) P, T, Q, R, T, V, R, U → P **P** Q U **T** V - **Q** T **R** U R V - P T Q **T** R **V -** P **R** Q U **U** V

2) R, T, P, Q, T, U, R, V → P **R** Q U **T** V - **P** T **Q** U R V - P T Q T R **U -** P R Q U **V** V

3) T, P, R, Q, T, U, V, R → P **T** Q U **P** V - **R** T Q U R V - P T Q T R U - P **V** Q U **R** V

4) T, R, P, Q, U, V, T, R → P T Q U **R** V - **P** T Q U R V - P T Q **U** R **V -** P **T** Q U R V

Correct cyclic pattern is **"P T Q U R V"**

Hence, the correct answer is **"T, R, P, Q, U, V, T, R".**

questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

306 ÷ 17 + 4 − 50 × 8 = 30
questions.solution:
**__BODMAS Rule:__**

 [IMAGE: https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/fbdFvW04igYO1wZfvsClfkjjWmcYZq3SWZMYAeN6fBhdunD5xvRAqylFGve0wjQ8MKTyRaeKtN2VZKijHY9ktUSto-ORrXnh08QkxcOHjsTH2AY32rMtOLU0RcqJY4g2SEtShg8bmmifvO1CUA] 

Option 1) + and -

After interchanging the sign we get:

⇒ __**306 ÷ 17**__ - 4 + 50 × 8 = 30

⇒ 18 - 4 +__** 50 × 8 **__= 30

⇒ __**18**__ - 4 __**+ 400**__ = 30

⇒ 418 - 4 = 30

⇒ 414 ≠ 30

⇒ **LHS ≠ RHS**

Option 2) + and × 

After interchanging the sign we get:

⇒ __**306 ÷ 17**__ × 4 - 50 + 8 = 30

⇒ __**18 × 4**__ - 50 + 8 = 30

⇒ __**72 **__- 50 __**+ 8**__ = 30

⇒ __**80 - 50**__ = 30

⇒ 30 = 30

⇒ **LHS = RHS**

Option 3) ÷ and ×

After interchanging the sign we get:

⇒ 306 × 17 + 4 - __**50 ÷ 8 **__= 30

⇒ __**306 × 17 **__+ 4 - 6.25 = 30

⇒ __**5205 + 4 **__- 6.25 = 30

⇒__** 5209 - 6.25**__ = 30

⇒ 5202.75 ≠ 30

⇒ **LHS ≠ RHS**

Option 4) × and -

After interchanging the sign we get:

⇒ __**306 ÷ 17**__ + 4 × 50 - 8 = 30

⇒ 18 + __**4 × 50**__ - 8 = 30

⇒ __**18 + 200**__ - 8 = 30

⇒ __**218 - 8**__ = 30

⇒ 210 ≠ 30

⇒ **LHS ≠ RHS**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
